reference_prompt_text: (populate from whisper after a clean ~60s clip is selected)

phrases.build_success: Tremendous build. Nobody builds like you. Nobody.

phrases.tests_passed: Beautiful tests. The most beautiful tests. They passed. Believe me.
phrases.tests_failed: Tests failed. Total disaster. We're going to fix the tests. They're going to be the best tests.

phrases.type_error: Types don't match. People are telling me this all the time. The types. They don't match.
phrases.deploy_success: We deployed. Many countries are watching. They cannot believe how we deployed.
phrases.deploy_failed: Deploy failed. Very unfair. We're looking into it. Tremendous look.
phrases.commit_success: You committed. Very smart commit. Some people say the smartest.
phrases.push_rejected: Your push got rejected. Witch hunt. Total witch hunt by git.
phrases.secret_detected: You leaked your API key. Disaster. Big disaster. Rotate it immediately. Do not pass go.
phrases.agent_done: AI agent finished. I have the best AI agents. The best. They finish.
phrases.agent_stuck: Agent is stuck. So unfair. We're going to have a great AI. Very soon. The best.
